SHIPPING_POLICY:
Shipping

We ship across Egypt and internationally. Every order is confirmed by email with its order number. Orders placed on weekends or public holidays are processed on the next working day.

Shipping in Egypt (EGP)

  • Cairo and Giza: Standard (2 to 5 working days) 85, free on orders over 2,999. Express (1 to 2 working days) 120.
  • Rest of Egypt (Alexandria, Delta, Canal cities, Upper Egypt, Red Sea, Sinai and Matrouh): Standard (2 to 5 working days) 85. Express (1 to 2 working days) 120.

Shipping outside Egypt (EGP)

  • Orders up to 4,000: 1,200
  • Orders over 4,000: 3,200

International delivery times depend on the destination and are confirmed by email after you order. Any customs duties or import taxes are paid by the customer.

The exact shipping cost is always shown at checkout before you pay.

Payment

Pay by card online, or cash on delivery within Egypt.

Questions

Email mim@mimcreativewear.com or call customer service on +201102220008.
REFUND_POLICY:
Exchanges

If you are not happy with your piece, you can exchange it within 2 days of receiving your order.

  • Items must be unworn, unwashed and unused, with all tags and packaging in place.
  • To arrange an exchange, email mim@mimcreativewear.com or call customer service on +201102220008 with your order number.
  • You pay the delivery costs for an exchange.
  • Requests made after 2 days may be declined. If we accept a late exchange, an extra fee of EGP 50 is added to the delivery charge.

Faulty, damaged or wrong items

Every piece is quality checked before it ships. If you receive a piece with a manufacturing fault, damage, or the wrong item or size, tell us within 2 days of delivery at mim@mimcreativewear.com. We will replace it if it is in stock, or refund the price of the item once we receive it back.

Refunds

Approved refunds are issued after we receive and inspect the item, to your original payment method. For cash on delivery orders we will agree the refund method with you.

Not covered

  • Items that have been worn, washed or altered
  • Normal wear and tear
  • Small variations in print, colour or size: every piece is printed by hand, so no two are exactly alike
PRIVACY_POLICY:
MIM Creative Wear ("we", "us") runs mimcreativewear.com. This policy explains what personal information we collect and how we use it.

Information we collect

  • Details you give us when you order or contact us: name, email, phone number, delivery and billing address, and order details.
  • Payment details are handled by our payment providers through Shopify's secure checkout. We do not store your full card number.
  • Information collected automatically when you browse: device and browser type, IP address, pages viewed, and cookies.

How we use it

  • To process, deliver and support your orders, including exchanges and refunds
  • To answer your questions
  • To send marketing emails if you subscribe. You can unsubscribe at any time.
  • To understand how our website is used, improve it, and measure and show our ads, using tools such as Google Analytics and Google Ads
  • To prevent fraud and meet legal obligations

Sharing

We share information only with the services that help us run the store: Shopify (our store platform), payment providers, delivery companies, and analytics and advertising partners such as Google. We do not sell your personal information.

Cookies

We use cookies to keep your cart and currency, remember your preferences, and measure site and ad performance. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Some parts of the site may not work without them.

Keeping your information

We keep order information for as long as needed for our records, accounting and legal obligations.

Your choices and rights

You can ask to see, correct or delete your personal information by emailing mim@mimcreativewear.com.
